Wildflower is a multicolor original sewn design encoded in 14 formats.
The original Needle fixtures exercise the other 22 extension routes using
small stitch streams with representative jumps and thread changes where
available. The TAP and EXY files reuse Wildflower's Tajima stitch stream.

The oracle records the previously shipped preview from the pinned pystitch
reader and the existing Rust VIP, JEF+ and JPX decoder. Each digest covers
the ordered sewn segments as four little-endian signed 32-bit coordinates
(start X/Y and end X/Y) followed by their three RGB bytes.
